probe reports every capability id, is side-effect free and its evidence carries the run kind

normalized error categories are the documented ones
createBucket is idempotent per token; a name collision is a conflict (not a silent reuse)
timeout after the side effect is uncertain; findBucketByToken reconciles; no second bucket
a new bucket is private (no public access); a public-read policy is visible on inspect
lifecycle: expiry and multipart-abort need their capability; transitions only if supported
credentials are scoped to ONE bucket: a credential of bucket A is useless on bucket B; a read credential cannot write; revoked credentials stop working
signed URLs: valid until expiry, method-scoped, a tampered signature or path is rejected, an expired URL is rejected
usage: bytes counted; requests/egress are null when the provider cannot report them (never estimated)
deleting a non-empty bucket needs force; delete is idempotent; the name becomes free again
compat report lists every operation tested; unsupported capabilities show up as unsupported operations
unsupported bucket/policy/signed-url/scoped-credential capabilities are failed/unsupported

probe reports every capability id, is side-effect free and its evidence carries the run kind
health and catalog are read-only; regions from a mock/fixture are never verified; a plan without a price carries no price
normalized error categories are the documented ones
verifyDomain is idempotent and returns the required records declaratively (ownership, SPF, DKIM)
checkDomain reflects verification; an unknown domain is not_found
a send from an unverified domain is refused by the provider adapter (failed/validation) and bills nothing
send is idempotent per key: a replay makes NO second provider send
a timeout after acceptance is uncertain; findByToken proves it; the retry sends nothing new. A timeout before acceptance is proven absent.
parseWebhook accepts a correctly signed payload inside the replay window
parseWebhook rejects: no signature, a forged signature, a tampered body, a replay outside the window, malformed JSON
suppression sync lists provider suppressions; without the capability it is failed/unsupported
an outage on send is a definitive, retryable failure; nothing is accepted
usage reports provider-accepted counts or null (never estimated); unsupported usage is failed/unsupported

dnsRequirements returns MX, SPF, DKIM and ownership records declaratively, plus DMARC guidance (p=none start)
provisioning needs a verified domain (failed/validation otherwise) and is idempotent per token

aliases: add and remove; quota: set; unsupported capabilities are failed/unsupported

usage: storage is reported per mailbox or null when the provider cannot report it (never estimated)
